title: Fox in Heartlit Nightmare
description: A detailed fox stands in the foreground of a decaying ornate room, surrounded by broken teacups, paint splatters and glowing magenta hearts dripping from thin black stems. In the background a massive grotesque tree-like monster with a pale cracked face, glowing white eyes and sharp teeth looms against a vibrant green starry sky.
prompt: A realistic fox standing in an abandoned elegant room with peeling walls and a lit wall sconce, broken teacups and paint on the floor, swarms of glowing bright pink hearts floating on black stems, in the background a giant terrifying tree creature with a humanoid cracked pale face, glowing white eyes and wide sharp-toothed grin emerging from twisted branches against a vibrant green starry night sky, dark surreal fantasy style
